entities.summary: Ralph Yirikian is an Armenian businessman who is the current General Director of Ucom, and was formerly the General Director of VivaCell-MTS, a 2005 startup company which became Armenia's leading telecommunications operator and one of the top taxpayers. As reported, he left the company in 2022 to concentrate on his own business.
